name: nahuya
description: Over-engineering review for Claude Code: a manual reviewer that proves what it calls unused, a pre-push review-and-fix loop, and a tiny layer that makes unrequested additions visible.

gate.title: Pre-push gate
gate.description: Block a push that carries enough unreviewed code until the nahuya:polish review loop has run.

threshold.title: Gate threshold (lines)
threshold.description: Unreviewed added lines of non-test, non-generated code that trigger the review. Counted across pushes since the last review.

max_rounds.title: Max review rounds
max_rounds.description: Upper bound on review-and-fix rounds per loop.

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model for the reviewer subagent. inherit uses the session's model.

fix_mode.title: How to save fixes
fix_mode.description: commit: one new commit on top. amend: fold into HEAD if it isn't pushed yet. uncommitted: leave fixes in the working tree and don't push.

layer.title: Persistent layer
layer.description: At session start, ask Claude to list unrequested additions as `added: X — why` lines (about 120 tokens).
